image_prompts.prompt: Full body shot of the character-consistent Ankylosaurus from the libraries.characters.dino_racer_ankylosaurus config in a moment of tripping while running on the dirt track. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Extremely wide and squat frame; slate-grey stony armor; deep moss-green lower skin; pale cream-colored side spikes. Broad triangular head with exactly four backward-pointing horns and amber eyes. Heavy, chipped slate-grey bone tail club. ACTION: He is caught mid-stride, one front leg is buckling inward, and his body is tilted precariously to one side, almost scraping the ground. His massive head is twisted, and his tail club is swinging wildly upward, trying to act as a counterweight. A loose rock or small divot in the dirt is visible directly under his compromised foot. Significant dust is being kicked up from his sudden shift in balance. SETTING: Clear, bright LANCE_HELL_CREEK dirt track. FACIAL EXPRESSION: A rare look of wide-eyed panic and strain, with his beak slightly agape, struggling to regain balance. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3'. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC'. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' dynamic side-profile, emphasizing the precarious balance and his struggle.
